points.point: Where a carousel made through n8n is saved
points.sentence: All the visuals you generate are saved in Videos, however you created them (web app, n8n or Make.com, REST API, or MCP).

points.point: How to find it when it's not showing in the app
points.sentence: If you cannot find one, go to my.blotato.com/videos and look for your recent creations there.

verdict.reason: The entry says visuals made through n8n are saved in Videos and tells the customer where to look for recent creations.
